items.en: Let agents focus on your business logic. The foundation is ready.
items.zh: 让 Agent 专心写业务，底座已经就绪。

items.en: NocoBase Core is the open-source application foundation for business systems built and run with AI. Permissions, workflows, files, and other building blocks come ready to use, so agents build only what is specific to your business, all on one consistent architecture.
items.zh: NocoBase Core 是 AI 开发和运行业务系统的开源应用底座。权限、流程、文件等基础能力现成可用，Agent 在统一架构上只开发企业自己的业务。

items.en: Free, open source, and ready for production
items.zh: 开源免费，可以直接用于生产

items.en: Your code and data belong to you
items.zh: 代码和数据归企业所有

items.en: Works with Claude Code, Codex, and dozens of other coding tools
items.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Codex 等数十种编码工具

items.en: Proven building blocks, ready to use.
items.zh: 基础能力不用从头开发和验证。

items.en: Even with AI writing the code, permissions, workflow engines, and approvals are hard to design from scratch. They are full of edge cases and take a lot of work to maintain. Core provides ready-made building blocks, and NocoBase keeps maintaining and upgrading them. Agents build only the business logic, so there is far less code to write and verify.
items.zh: 即使交给 AI，权限、工作流引擎、审批等底层模块从零开发，设计难度依然很高，边界情况多，维护工作量大。Core 提供现成的基础能力，由 NocoBase 持续维护和升级。Agent 只开发业务部分，需要开发和验证的代码大幅减少。

items.en: Passwords, resets, and sessions; OIDC single sign-on, social login, and two-factor authentication
items.zh: 密码登录、找回密码、会话；OIDC 统一身份、社交登录、双因素认证

items.en: Activate and deactivate accounts, invite links, and role assignment
items.zh: 账号启用与停用、邀请链接、分配角色

items.en: Access to pages, actions, and data, the same for people and agents
items.zh: 页面、操作和数据范围的授权，人与 Agent 用同一套

items.en: Default data scope, sharing rules, and restriction rules
items.zh: 默认数据范围、共享规则、限制规则

items.en: For scripts, other systems, and the command line
items.zh: 供脚本、外部系统和命令行访问应用

items.en: Tables, fields, relations, and migrations on SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and Oracle
items.zh: 数据表、字段、关联和迁移；SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、Oracle

items.en: Browse existing connections, tables, and fields
items.zh: 浏览已有数据库的连接、数据表和字段

items.en: Upload, store, preview, and download, linked to business records
items.zh: 上传、存储、预览和下载，文件与业务记录关联

items.en: Contracts, quotes, and other documents from Office templates
items.zh: 按 Office 模板生成合同、报价单等文档

items.en: States and transitions declared in code, with full handling history
items.zh: 状态和流转在代码里声明，保留完整的处理历史

items.en: Flow diagrams and run history; admins adjust approvers and thresholds
items.zh: 流程图和执行记录，管理员可以调整审批人、金额阈值

items.en: Run on a schedule, with every run recorded
items.zh: 按时间规则执行，记录每次执行

items.en: Multi-level, all-sign, any-sign, add a signer, transfer, and send back
items.zh: 多级、会签、或签、加签、转交、退回

items.en: One to-do list across every business source
items.zh: 汇总各业务来源的个人待办
通知的发送、投递和日志

items.en: SMTP and Resend email, Feishu and DingTalk group bots
items.zh: SMTP、Resend 邮件，飞书、钉钉群机器人

items.en: Connect mailboxes to sync, reply, and send, with threads linked to records
items.zh: 关联个人邮箱，同步、回复和发送，往来邮件与业务记录关联

items.en: Agent definitions, model services, runs, and conversations
items.zh: Agent 定义、模型服务、运行和对话

items.en: Chat in the browser with the coding tools on members’ computers
items.zh: 在浏览器里和成员电脑上的编码工具对话

items.en: Versioned documents and files with full-text search, for people and agents
items.zh: 带版本的文档和文件、全文检索，供人和 Agent 使用

items.en: The page framework and UI library: tables, boards, flow diagrams, and more
items.zh: 页面框架和 UI 组件库，表格、看板、流程图等

items.en: Language switching, plus light, dark, and compact modes
items.zh: 界面语言切换，浅色、深色和紧凑模式
命令行部署、升级与回滚

items.en: See which Core building blocks an app uses
items.zh: 查看应用用到了哪些 Core 能力

items.en: 20+ building blocks, maintained and upgraded by NocoBase.
items.zh: 20 多项基础能力，由 NocoBase 持续维护和升级。

items.en: Read the Docs for Each One
One architecture, one set of standards.
items.zh: 为 Agent 提供统一的架构和规范。

items.en: Switch developers, models, or even sessions, and the AI may improvise differently each time. The system gets harder and harder to maintain. Core provides one project structure and one set of development standards, so the system evolves steadily for years on a consistent architecture.
items.zh: 换人、换模型甚至换会话，AI 都可能随机发挥，系统越来越难维护。Core 提供统一的项目结构和开发规范，系统在统一架构下长期稳定迭代。

items.en: Every new app starts with the same layout. Pages, endpoints, schema changes, and tests each have a fixed place, and Core’s building blocks come in as packages.
items.zh: 新建的应用自带统一的目录：页面、接口、表结构变更、测试各有固定位置，Core 的基础能力以包的形式引入。

items.en: AGENTS.md and the skills spell out where business code goes, what to take from Core, and how to write migrations and permission checks.
items.zh: AGENTS.md 和技能写明业务代码放在哪里、哪些直接用现成能力、迁移和权限怎么写。

items.en: Skills ship with Core’s packages and sync into the app on install. Claude Code, Codex, and other coding tools read the same playbook, so the approach holds as people and models change.
items.zh: 技能随 Core 的包发布，安装依赖时同步到应用里。Claude Code、Codex 等编码工具读到的是同一套写法，换人、换模型也不变。

items.en: Building with a team of people and agents: NocoBase Studio
items.zh: 多人、多个 Agent 一起开发：NocoBase Studio

items.en: You own your apps and data.
items.zh: 应用和数据归企业私有。

items.en: Core is free and open source. Your business code and data stay in your own repositories and on your own servers, and you choose your own models and agents.
items.zh: Core 开源免费，业务代码和数据都在企业自己的仓库和服务器上，模型和 Agent 也由企业自由选择。
在 GitHub 上查看源码

items.en: Core, NocoCRM, NocoReach, and NocoProject are free, open source, and ready for production.
items.zh: Core 以及 NocoCRM、NocoReach、NocoProject 开源免费，可以直接用于生产。

items.en: Core, Solution, and Studio all run on your own servers. Your code and data belong to you.
items.zh: Core、Solution 和 Studio 都部署在企业自己的服务器上，代码和数据归企业所有。

items.en: Your choice of models and agents
items.zh: 模型与 Agent 自由选择

items.en: No vendor lock-in. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and other coding tools, and with a wide range of models.
items.zh: 不绑定厂商，支持 Claude Code、Codex 等编码工具和各类大模型。

items.en: Once released, your business apps run on their own. Day-to-day business requests never go through Studio.
items.zh: 业务应用发布后独立运行，日常业务请求不经过 Studio。
选择适合你们团队的起点。

items.en: Build your own system on Core
items.zh: 用 Core 开发自己的系统

items.en: Agents use Core’s ready-made building blocks and build only what is specific to your business.
items.zh: Agent 使用 Core 的现成能力，只开发企业自己的业务部分。

items.en: Use it as it is, or have a coding agent tailor it to your business.
items.zh: 可以直接安装使用，也可以让 Coding Agent 根据自己的业务需求定制。
带领 Agent 团队开发

items.en: Agents keep the work moving. Your team stays in control.
items.zh: Agent 自主推进，团队掌控全局。

items.en: Core and every Solution app are free, open source, and ready for production.
items.zh: Core 和所有 Solution 开源免费，可以直接用于生产。
